programme.title: Rascal Flatts: Life Is a Highway Tour: Live from Columbus
programme.desc: Country superstars Rascal Flatts celebrate 25 years of music with a hometown performance in Columbus, Ohio, recorded on their Life Is a Highway Tour. The set features timeless hits like Bless the Broken Road, What Hurts the Most, Mayberry, Fast Cars and Freedom, and Life Is a Highway. Between songs, the band reflects on their journey, faith, and the fans who made it all possible in an evening filled with nostalgia, gratitude, and classic country harmony.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Lizzo shows up fully in everything she does, tracing her journey from a diamond record to a fall tour.

programme.title: Coheed and Cambria: Live at Starland Ballroom
programme.desc: Coheed and Cambria performs live at Starland Ballroom, delivering standout tracks from their first two albums in a high-energy hometown concert.

programme.title: Melissa Villaseñor: Welp... What Now?
programme.desc: In her debut stand-up special, SNL alum Melissa Villaseñor reflects on her six seasons at Saturday Night Live, life after fame, and finding herself through humor, music, and culture. Recorded live at the historic Bob Baker Marionette Theater in Highland Park, Los Angeles, with musical guests Wolves of Glendale, Villaseñor blends sharp impressions, heartfelt storytelling, and songs in a deeply personal and hilarious set.

programme.title: Flogging Molly: Live from Las Vegas
programme.desc: Flogging Molly performs a St. Patrick’s Day celebration live from Las Vegas with a high-energy set.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.sub-title: Rory Rodriguez of Dayseeker on Artist Friendly
programme.desc: In this moving conversation, Dayseeker frontman Rory Rodriguez joins Joel Madden to open up about therapy, grief, and fatherhood. Rory shares how losing his father and becoming one himself reshaped his life, how trauma informed his music, and how therapy helped him rediscover balance. A candid look at vulnerability, resilience, and creative healing through pain and art.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.sub-title: Morgan Lander of Kittie on Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Morgan Lander, frontwoman of Canadian heavy metal band Kittie, joins Joel Madden to discuss breaking into the metal scene as teenage girls, reclaiming power in a male-dominated industry, and redefining success on their own terms. Lander reflects on burnout, body autonomy, and growing up in the spotlight before returning stronger than ever.

programme.title: Carmen Christopher: Live from the Windy City
programme.desc: Comedian Carmen Christopher returns home to Chicago for a sharp, surreal, and hilarious stand-up special that blends the absurd with the heartfelt. With quick wit and offbeat honesty, Christopher riffs on social media, family, dating, politics, and Midwest life in a performance that’s both painfully self-aware and laugh-out-loud ridiculous. Executive produced by Tim Robinson and Zach Kanin.

programme.title: Frank Turner: Live from Shamrock Rebellion
programme.desc: Recorded live at Flogging Molly’s Shamrock Rebellion festival in Las Vegas, singer-songwriter Frank Turner and his band The Sleeping Souls deliver a high-energy performance filled with punk spirit, sharp storytelling, and crowd-fueled anthems. Featuring songs like I Still Believe, 1933, Girl from the Record Shop, and Never Mind the Back Problems, this exclusive Veeps concert captures Turner’s trademark mix of rebellion, heart, and unity.

programme.title: Iron & Wine and Band of Horses: Live From Los Angeles
programme.desc: Iron & Wine and Band of Horses perform a co-headlining concert live from The Wiltern in Los Angeles.

programme.title: Jessi Cruickshank: Minivan Money
programme.desc: Comedian and TV host Jessi Cruickshank takes the stage in Toronto for her first stand-up special, Minivan Money. Known as “the funniest woman on television” (The Province), Cruickshank dives into the chaos of motherhood with biting honesty and fearless humor. From pumping breastmilk onstage to lusting after preschool dads, she turns the absurd realities of parenting into sharp, self-aware comedy. Blending storytelling, satire, and confessional wit, this live performance captures a comedian in full command of her craft — raw, real, and hilariously relatable.

programme.title: Nos Amis
programme.desc: Nos Amis follows Eagles of Death Metal members Jesse Hughes and Josh Homme as they recount their experiences before, during, and after the 2015 terrorist attack at the Bataclan Theatre in Paris. Blending intimate interviews, archival footage, and emotional reflection, the documentary explores trauma, friendship, and the unifying power of rock and roll. Directed by Colin Hanks, it chronicles the band’s emotional return to Paris and their effort to reclaim joy and connection through music.

programme.title: Incubus: Look Alive
programme.desc: Incubus performs live on the Light Grenades Tour, featuring a Chicago concert and behind-the-scenes moments from life on the road.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Singer-songwriter Jax joins Joel Madden for an honest, funny, and emotional conversation about her deep love of emo music, growing up performing in bands, navigating online comments, and building a creative life on her own terms. From her early days opening for Good Charlotte to finding her authentic voice, Jax opens up about confidence, empathy, and artistic growth.

programme.title: Modern Wisdom
programme.sub-title: The Case Against Condoms & Fake Friendship
programme.desc: Why do humans act so complicated? We’re simple creatures, farts are funny, everyone does awkward stuff, yet we all pretend we don’t. Maybe life gets better when you lean into the weird instead of hiding it. So how do you embrace being different and find the fun instead of stressing about it? Expect to learn how Rick’s brain works, what his favourite show and jokes are and how they shaped him, the top things that are difficult to look cool while doing, why using "condoms" with friends are useless, how to handle our people pleasing tendencies for good, why humans are so hard to interact with at times, the awkward feelings of becoming intimate with someone, the biggest message Rick Glassman wants to give out in the world and much more…

programme.title: Modern Wisdom
programme.sub-title: The Most Important Daily Habits For Health & Longevity
programme.desc: Determining the best actions to take for enhancing our health and extending our lives has grown more challenging. There are an unlimited number of wellness approaches at our disposal, thankfully Dr Patrick has dedicated her professional life to identifying the most evidence-based strategies for improving our health and longevity. Expect to learn if low omega 3s are worse for you than smoking cigarettes, what Rhonda's thoughts are on vaping and nicotine, the best foods to boost your metabolism, the once a week workout that can de-age your heart by 20 years, how to get the benefits of heat exposure if you don't have a sauna, the terrifying health risks of being too sedentary and much more...

programme.title: Modern Wisdom
programme.sub-title: Why Fear & Horror Feels Kinda Good
programme.desc: Why are we drawn to fear? This fascination often balances us the edge of life and death, infused with a dash of excitement. From his beginnings as a Navy SEAL to becoming a renowned YouTuber, Mr. Ballen possesses a unique storytelling talent. He captivates us with some of the most spine-chilling true stories, drawn both from his experiences and the lives of others. Expect to learn why so many people are obsessed with True Crime and scary stories, the 3 terrifying but true stories MrBallen has prepared in this episode today, what being a NAVY Seal taught MrBallen about life & the backlash he has gotten from the NAVY Seal community by sharing his story, what it means to live a good life, if there is life after death, how to reinvent your entire life, what it takes to tell a good story and much more...
